  "chunks": [
    {
      "chunk_type": "isnad",
      "arabic_text": "حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَرْقِيُّ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْبَرْقِيِّ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ مَاجِيلَوَيْهَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ عِيسَى الْمَجَاوِرُ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَاجِيلَوَيْهَ، عَن أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَن أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ السَّيَّارِيُّ، عَن عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ",
      "translations": {
        "en": "Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah al-Barqi, and Muhammad ibn al-Barqi, and Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh, and Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Hashim, and Ali ibn Isa al-Majiluwayh, and Ali ibn Isa al-Mujawir (may God be pleased with them) narrated that Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Majiluwayh, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari, from Ali ibn Asbat, who said: 'I said to Al-Rida (peace be upon him):'"
      }
    },
    {
      "chunk_type": "body",
      "arabic_text": "يَحْدُثُ الْأَمْرُ لَا أَجِدُ بُدًّا مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي الْبَلَدِ الَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ أَحَدٌ أَسْتَفْتِيهِ مِنْ مَوَالِيكَ قَالَ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ائْتِ فَقِيهَ الْبَلَدِ فَاسْتَفْتِهِ فِي أَمْرِكَ فَإِذَا أَفْتَاكَ بِشَيْءٍ فَخُذْ بِخِلَافِهِ فَإِنَّ الْحَقَّ فِيهِ.",
      "translations": {
        "en": "'An issue arises and I have no choice but to know its ruling, but there is no one in the town where I am from your followers whom I can ask for a fatwa.' He said, and he (peace be upon him) said: 'Go to the jurisprudent of the town and ask him about your issue. When he gives you a fatwa, take the opposite of it, for the truth is in it.'"
      }
    }
  ],

The unique ruling is that one should take the opposite of the faqih's opinion, as the truth lies in the contrary, a concept often associated with the principle of ihtiyat (precaution) or the specific epistemological status of the faqih's opinion in this context.",
      "seo_question": "What is the ruling on consulting a local jurisprudent according to Imam al-Rida?",
